safety: Setup, Prisma Client generation, tests, and builds must use local/test resources only. Never provide production database URLs or production credentials to setup or local tests.

tools.Purpose: Required JavaScript runtime; the exact version is pinned in .node-version and is inside the package.json engine range.
tools.Installation: Install Node.js 22.19.0 with nvm, fnm, or the root development-container configuration.
tools.Environment: Local development, Codespaces, development container, CI

tools.Purpose: Installs the exact dependency graph from package-lock.json and runs project scripts.
tools.Installation: Use the npm version bundled with the pinned Node.js runtime; do not install npm globally.
tools.Verification: npm --version (npm run tools:verify checks the supported major)
tools.Environment: Local development, Codespaces, development container, CI

tools.Verification: npm ls next and npm run build

tools.Purpose: Application type checking and typed configuration/tests.
Schema tooling, isolated-test migrations, and Prisma Client generation.
tools.Environment: Local development, CI, production build (generation only)

tools.Purpose: Application database access; must remain version-aligned with the Prisma CLI.
tools.Installation: npm ci followed by npm run db:generate

tools.Purpose: Browser E2E, responsive, route, and accessibility verification.
tools.Installation: npm ci followed by npm run setup (Chromium); npm run browsers:install -- --all for optional Firefox/WebKit.
tools.Verification: npm run tools:verify and npm run test:e2e:isolated
tools.Required/Optional: Required for E2E; other browser engines optional
tools.Environment: Local development, Codespaces, development container, CI

tools.Version: Chromium revision bundled with the locked Playwright version
tools.Purpose: Default browser used by Aurevia E2E, browser smoke tests, and Lighthouse audits.
tools.Installation: npm run setup or npm run browsers:install
tools.Environment: Local development, Codespaces, development container, CI

tools.Purpose: Runs accessibility scans in the Playwright E2E suite.
Repository linting and JavaScript/TypeScript quality checks.
The project has no separate formatter dependency or formatter script; use the existing ESLint configuration and repository style.

tools.Environment: Local development, CI when explicitly requested

tools.Purpose: Clone-based workflows, version control, and CI checkout; not needed to unpack a ZIP.
tools.Installation: Use the operating system package manager or the GitHub-hosted CI runner.
tools.Required/Optional: Required for clone and contribution workflows

tools.Version: Docker Engine 20.10+ and Docker Compose v2+
tools.Purpose: Runs the disposable loopback-only PostgreSQL database for isolated Playwright tests and optional local services.
tools.Installation: Install Docker Desktop or Docker Engine with the Compose v2 plugin from the official Docker source; Codespaces uses the configured Docker-outside-of-Docker feature.
tools.Verification: docker --version, docker compose version, and docker info
tools.Required/Optional: Optional generally; required for isolated E2E and Compose workflows
tools.Environment: Local development, Codespaces, development container, CI

tools.Purpose: Local/test database for Prisma and Playwright; psql and pg_isready are supplied inside the container.
tools.Installation: Docker pulls the official PostgreSQL image when npm run test:e2e:isolated starts.
tools.Required/Optional: Optional for application development; required for isolated E2E
tools.Environment: Local development, Codespaces, development container, CI

tools.Purpose: Runs repository CI using the pinned Node version, npm lockfile, tests, browsers, and build.
tools.Installation: Provided by GitHub-hosted runners; no local global installation.

tools.Purpose: Existing production hosting and deployment-hook integration; no Render CLI is used by this repository.
tools.Installation: Managed in the existing Render service and dashboard; do not replace or recreate it from development setup.
tools.Verification: Production operator checks deployment status in Render.
